notes.title: Update 1.6.1
notes.content:
A Milestone update focusing mostly on sound synthesis:

[previewyoutube="uU5__TO2-nE;full"][/previewyoutube]
New
- New Object : SwarmOSC : Monophonic oscillator with up to 128 unison voices and spread/scale parameters.

- New Object : Spike : Band pass / notch filter with up to 16 stages for ultra precise and heavy filtering.

- New Object : Filler : Generates new triggers to fill the time between received input triggers according synced delta division.

- Sample : Loader : Convert to Mono -option for sample file loader.

- Roll : When not recording, Sync input with a trigger does a time jump to a beat corresponding the sync number value.

- Gate : New mode : Pass : Transmits only the received Sync number, without a Trigger.

- All Filters : Toggleable Mono mode to optimize DSP load for mono signals.

- Vector : New mode P-Link, where both X and Y values are linked to Y probablity selection. Toggle from object menu.

- Automation Sequencer : Control from MIDI buttons sends back the message to the selected MIDI output port for controller's LED lights.

- New Example project : Basic goa trance setup in Indian tuning.


Fixes
- Matrix : Fixed a chrashing bug when opening projects files made with a software version older than 1.5.9.

- Auto-Filter : Added a visual indicator to the Envelope function.

- Roll : Velocity values fixed for note recording from Sync input.

- Roll : Minimum limit to recorded note lengths (for MIDI drums etc)

- Wavetable : High frequency oscillation fixed.

- Pad : Current X/Y position drawn on the GUI.

- Model : Switched parameter places so that the more imporant Damp parameter has more graphical resolution.

- Input Vector : Delta steps amount change now updates correctly.

- Automation Sequencer : Update back to object GUI improved.

- Various small UI fixes

notes.title: Update 1.5.9
notes.content:
Larger update to add many new features, focusing on the Matrix object, and making most if not all current features stable and sane. Demo version is also updated. 

This one will have it's own branch (in steam Betas) as the current stable and for possible hot fixes etc. while the next major update (1.6.0) will introduce new larger experimental features. 


New	
- New object : Silencer : Alters trigger signal velocity values with a limiter and a random variation. 
- New object : Reaction : Generates On and Off trigger signals according met and lost arithmetic conditions (similarly to Data Filter).
- Matrix : New mode : Random : The generation process ignores Markov history and selects each step with stochastic probablity only. 
- Matrix : New option : Rests : While learning, creates also silent rest nodes from the gaps between notes, improving melodic use. Rests are calculated after the first received note. Rest delta nodes in the Matrix editor are marked with (R). 
- Filters, Delay, Reverb and Model: Reset function (object menu) to reset object's DSP code if it has blown up (without project reload).
- New General Manual page to explain control signal conversions and signal strip.

[previewyoutube=06v69twx5Sk;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes
- Sample : Editor : Selecting a slice in Slice mode, now sets also the A-B range in Select mode accordingly, where sample data can be erased.
- Button : Creating a trigger by clicking a Button object adds also a full velocity value to the signal.
- Button : If a button object is named "Start", "Pause" or "Reset" it will be triggered according the corresponding global time event. 
- Tuner : Editor : Added a visualisation of frequency interferences and a possibility to change the base comparison node (to other than 1.0) 	
- Tuner : Editor : Currently playing tone/ratio of the edited Tuner object is show on the editor view. 
- Data Filter : New modes including On and Off that pass only signals with On or Off triggers accordingly. 

Fixes	
- Automation Sequencer : When opening a project with automation tracks and mapping, it works without the need to open the automation editor first. 
- Automation Sequencer : CC button controls (velocity 127 =on, 0 = off) now maps correctly to Switch/Button UI elements. 
- Sample : Monophonic instrument (Instr) mode optimized. 
- Oscillators : Precise low frequency playback for Hz values with decimals (Oscillator, PolyOSC, Wavetable). 
- Variation : No more repeating values, if the range allows it. 
- Omitter : Fixed a bug where a cv sync value got stuck into the object's output. 
- Operator : When receiving a trigger in Negative (NEG) mode, On trigger will turn into Off trigger and vice versa. 
- Button : fires an Off trigger when clicked with secondary or third mouse button.
- Matrix : When in Halt mode, the received trigger and sync signals have no effect. 
- Roll & Plot : Play Once -modes not starting with global time start, only when triggered to play. 
- Matrix : Editor : Endpoint nodes now drawn correctly and other UI fixes. 
- Matrix : Optimization to learning from live input. 
- MIDI In : Fixed stuck velocity issue from Mono AG (Auto-glide) mode. 
- UI : Signal background visual now drawn with lines instead of dots.
- Tuner : Editor : numerator and period number fields now accept also decimal numbers.  
- Tuner : Non-octave scala file load fixed.
- Envelope : Mode parameter ui bug fixed. 
- UI : Various other fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.5.8
notes.content:
New: 
- New object : Global : Control global app functions like Play, Pause and Rewind with triggers.  
- New object : Converter : Convert sync signals from number to CV and from CV to number.
- New object : Jog : Use a jog wheel of a MIDI DJ controller as note input  (guitar-like strumming).
- New object : Input Vector : Number value store, controllable with defined deltas selected by input values.
- Tuner : editor : Added a Hz field. 
- Gate : new mode : Switch (previous default is now Shot) turns the Gate open until receiving an off trigger. 
- Monitor : new  Input data filter modes.
- Arcade : new mode : switch X/Time generation between the vector and analogue stick movements (guitar-like pick)
- Arcade : new mode : switch Y/Value generation between dynamic and fixed position.
- Automation Sequencer : Range scaler for CC (0-127) MIDI signals to more limited actual parameter values. 

Fixes
- Tuner : non-octave Scala file save/load fixed. 
- Envelope : now parameter edit doesn't affect the currently running envelope function. 
- Filter : added denormal optimization. Now a silence of multiple filters won't cause a DSP load surge.
- Render Screen : aspect ratio now fully dynamic.
- Matrix : editor : node view fixed for a large amount of delta nodes. 
- Model : the internal exciter now creates also a negative impulse. 
- Automation Sequencer : now MIDI signals are registered (to Learn etc) also by their MIDI channel.
- Gamepads : USB game controllers are now read at every 5ms to avoid data floods to the DSP. 
	
A bizarre bug where some audio interfaces leaked their analogue input signal into the audio renderer output is now very likely fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.5.7
notes.content:
New: 
- New object : Tape : buffered stereo audio file player for large audio files played directly from disk. 
- Matrix : data editor : edit and delete nodes from a network graph!
- Matrix : note/number velocities added to node data. Start button added to object panel. 
- Model : added a tracking mode, where the filter is always set according current input frequency. 
- Operator : new operation modes : NEGative number, ABSolute number. 
- Five new color themes from popular trends of 1950's to 1990's. 

Fixes & Changes: 
- Sample : fix to Poly : rapid Off trigger right after On trigger now fades correctly according release time.
- Sample : Slice mode remade to keep playing the loop, jumping to slice positions from input triggers, pausing from last+1 slice. 
- Compressor : when receiving silence from sidechain control, switches to autocompression.
- Map : inverse mode, maps to opposite direction (from scale subset to tuning set) Set from object menu. 
- Omitter : connection  to Pulse object is now sync connection (and not audio..)
- Spectre : Now captures frequency map layers from it's own audio input (from object menu)
- Button : converts Sample object's Start trigger (the first chunk/slice) into basic On trigger. 
- Hold : Now runs it's DSP even if master time is paused. 
- Arcade : up/down d-buttons don't trigger (only value change), and their deltas are doubled when 
                 double button hold. Now they also alter the monitor value when no voice is playing. 
- DSP : fixed buffersize 512 
- UI : many fixes

notes.title: Update 1.5.6
notes.content:
Fixes & Changes: 
	- Formant : More vowels, more partials and a gender option. 
	- Vector : with Ext on, trigger-only sync advances pattern and returns to rootValue. 
	- Vector : with Ext on, received triggers advance the sequence, even when global time is stopped. 
	- Arcade : Changed right analog stick to vector X, monitor modes fixed. 
	- Map : Lock option to prevent "Copy to All" from altering the locked mapping.
	- Pattern & Stochastic : Fixed step/unit advance from only ON triggers. 
	- Model : Tighter limits to input frequency and more NaN checks to reduce DSP-breaking glitches.
	
	Other:
	- A Control setting to disable new object auto-naming (creating only nameless objects)
	- Special fonts aligning and spacing fixed (Deutch, 8bit, Hybrid, Ballet, Gregorian)
	- New dark and light wintery color themes
	- Minor UI fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.5.5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MT39PhccUc4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

New objects types:

- Brush : Pointer-like monophonic instrument from defined MIDI input.
	Any MIDI device with at least few CC and Note controls can act as a strange Ouija theremin.
	
- GamePad : USB (and possibly wireless) gamepad's controls can be turned into CV and trigger messages. 
	Check and refresh connected devices from program's Control settings.

- Arcade : A gamepad-controlled vector sequencer. See it's manual how it works. 

Changes & Fixes:

- Monitor : Added various output modes, to block CV or Trigger or both signals.
- Model : Improvements to model excitation.
- Tuning editor : UI changes and new feature for moving both up and down with added intervals. 
- Various UI fixes
	
New Example project : "Maqam arcade" for gamepad controller (also in Demo version)

notes.title: Update 1.5.4
notes.content:
I took a short sabbatical from coding, and now back in action.

- MIDI In: New mode PolyTrig that is the same as Poly but without Note Off messages. 
- Vector : Improvements to octave syncing. 
- Data Filter : Repeating values pass through.
- UI: Various improvements and fixes.

[previewyoutube=bGTn5vpmv9I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 1.5.3
notes.content:
- UI : Lots of UI fixes and improvements.
- UI : New keyboard shortcuts to various object operations (see internal manual pages) 
- Sample : Instr mode envelope bug (slow attack with instant region change) fixed	
- Matrix : Improvements to sync (preventing too frequent async triggers that could cause glitches) 
	
- New example project added into the app (also the demo version): microtonal vector metal of physically modeled guitar synths. Something more wilder than the techno-house one.

notes.title: Update 1.5.2
notes.content:
- Sample : Major improvements: added sustain looping, slice envelope and various tweaks.
- Matrix : learning input doesn't need triggers anymore: also legato notes are received. 
- Matrix : Learn mode stay on when starting the global time.
- UI: All menu operations now have descriptions below the screen.
- UI: G key shows grid to where all objects and trays snap when moved around.
- UI: X key opens selected object's edit view (Sample, Tuner, RatioDriver, Wavetable and Reverb)

notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
- Vector : Bounce (BNC) now works with range probability:
The closer the current Y value is to Top limit, the less likely the next delta is going to be (a large) positive, and vice versa. 
	
- MIDI In : Monophonic autoglide mode (MONOAG) to simulate analog voltage keyboard (that glides up and down)
- Keys : MonoAG mode now works also backwards, gliding to lower notes than hold.

- New launch options for MIDI devices: Set the program to stay off MIDI input or output ports. 
 (For Windows version, where the same MIDI port cannot be used by more than one app)
	
- UI Fixes

notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
No drastic changes.

- Sample : Instr mode chunk volume/pan change when sliding between chunks fixed.

- Vector : new option Trigs : when not toggled, only external triggers pass and the vector itself is not creating new ones. (toggled by default)
- Vector : new option Once : when toggled, playing starts only from external trigger, and continues until Length is met.
 (not toggled by default)

- UI Fixes (Roll, Plot, Map)
- Parameter typing cancels when clicking anywhere but the edit field below.

notes.title: Update 1.4.9
notes.content:
- Fixed rendering bug of tool selection panel (screen all white/black with the default tool select mode) from 1.4.8
- Minor UI fixes.

This is going to be the current stable version, starting with more new features on 1.5.0

Demo version of the app is available soon, fully functional without MIDI, saving and loading of project and macro files.

notes.title: Update 1.4.8
notes.content:
- Sample : Instrument mode: de-triggering fixed, leaving no notes playing with master stop/reset 
- Omitter : Connection between two omitters now as Sync (instead of Trigger), so any numbers can pass through.
- Sample : Polyphonic playhead flooding prevented.

notes.title: Update 1.4.7
notes.content:
Severe memory leak bug found and fixed, that was likely introduced in 1.4.0. 
This could have crashed that app right on start on some setups.

notes.title: Update 1.4.6
notes.content:
Various fixes to improve monophonic (e.g. wind instrument) playing:

- Sample : (Monophonic) Instrument mode now slides between pitch chunks on triggerless changes.
- MIDI In : Improvements on Monophonic mode: velocity, triggerless change.

notes.title: Update 1.4.5
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Wavetable/PolyOSC : Polyphonic voices with velocity variation fixed. 
- MIDI In : Pitch Wheel events fixed: Bend translates to CV values between -1.0 and 1.0
- Scope : Output trigger state set to fixed IDLE.
- Matrix : Output Velocity amount set to fixed 1.0.

notes.title: Update 1.4.4
notes.content:
New Features:
- Roll : Truncate selection operation. Removes all unselected notes and sets the beats amount according the selection.
- Scope : Now also receives sync signals, and passes CV only forward by stripping all triggers and numbers.
- Sample : Single region sampler's pitch controlled modes (Instr and PolyI) fixed.
	
- Minor UI Fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4.3
notes.content:
New Features:
- "Copy over machine" function to all objects/trays : Copy selected object(s) parameters over all machine states.
Removes the hindrance to find and change the same parameter(s) in all machine states to match a preferred global state.
- Object's menu is now hinted when selecting.

Fixes:
- Spectre : movement between spectrum layers (pitch zones) is now smooth.
- DataFilter : fixed issues with multiple input connections order.
- Sample: monophonic instr mode now stops playing with program master stop/reset.
- Wavetable : monophonic mode stops playing with master stop/reset. 
- Matrix : parameter changes update to GUI when machine state changed. 

and other minor UI fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4.2
notes.content:
- Sample : triggered playback of very short, single region memory fixed. Memory less than 1 sec is drawn in greater detail.
- Vector : parameter automation fixed.
- Vector : "background sync"
	   when receiving external sync number without a trigger, the next value will be the input along vector's own timing.
- Automation sequencer stops with global stop/reset. 
- Monitor : faulty initializations with stuck triggers fixed (Monitor never passes any triggers forward) 
- UI : minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content:
- Map : Current value/unit is shown with a colored dot over.
- Slider : Fixed value initialization on project file load. 
- Sample : Polyphonic play-head flood prevented.
- UI : various minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
New: 

- 3D Sequence visualization of triggered frequencies and samples.
 Open and close with F7. Use A,W,S,D and Arrow Keys to alter view.

Changes and Fixes:

- Spectre : Pitch update rate limited to one per 50 samples, to prevent huge DSP loads with slidiging pitches.
- Roll : Clear all Rolls prompted operation.
- Vector : No off trigger on pause step (0+) when in percussive mode. 
	
- UI : double click to object body (hold & move on mouseover mode) will focus on object.
- UI : selecting a wide range of objects will also select the underlaying panels for moving around.

notes.title: Update 1.3.9
notes.content:
- Roll : view scrolling now with absolute cursor position.
- MIDI IN : Added AT/PolyAT/PC and old MIDI Note Off (velocity = 0), among other fixes.
AT/PC messages used to crash the program.
- Improvements to Auto-Filter, Hold objects.

notes.title: Update 1.3.8
notes.content:
- New Object: Auto-Filter, a multi-mode filter with volume controlled envelope follower. 
- Operator MOD mode: possible div by zero crashing bug fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.3.7
notes.content:
- Codec changes for better Windows cross-compatibility (this might help running in Win8 and Win11) 

- Minor fixes to Toggler, Switch and Roll objects.
- Minor fixes to UI.

notes.title: Update 1.3.6
notes.content:
- Sanity constraints to objects: Vector can follow only one external sync source (but multiple triggers)
- Minor fixes to UI. 

Version 1.3.x seems to be stable enough for proceeding with new features for 1.4
More user feedback and suggestions would be super nice.

notes.title: Update 1.3.5
notes.content:
New:
	- Pan on Zoom option : Moves the view x/y center when zooming, according mouse position (Control settings)

	Fixes:
	- Polyphonic velocity value passing fixed in several objects.
	- Switch object updates it's state correctly on project load.

notes.title: Update 1.3.4
notes.content:
New:
- Spectre object : Spectral synth that loads layers of frequency spectrum data (currently only from audio files) 
  and synthesizes an audio signal by comb-filtering white noise according the layers, that each defines 
  a texture for it's frequency range (defined by the layer's base frequency)
  Can also run as additive synthesis with sinewaves instead of filtered noise. 

Fixes:
- PolyOSC & Wavetable : Zero velocity triggers are now converted to full velocity.
- Keys : Initial output value set to zero.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3
notes.content:
New:
	- Background picture system, for setting image files into the background (open with 'P'-key, set blend with +/- ) 
	  No saving yet for the picture collages (should they be inside the project file, or just save paths to the files?)
	
	Changes & Fixes:
	- Vector: Octave wrapping (Oct), to keep the current octave range, while reading external notes.
	- Roll: Snap (to grid) mode option, instead of only "no grid" being without snap. 
	  Seeing the Grid is very useful without snapping too. 
	- Roll: Improvements to mouseover functionalities.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
New:
	- New mid century / film noir -inspired fonts and a black/white-ish color theme for UI.

	Changes:
	- UI rendering optimization for Vector object. 
	- Confirmation dialog added for state machine's State deletion.
	- Current state name shown after project name on the top bar. 
	- Roll: on project/tray load, the view scrolls automatically to the lowest note. 
	
	Bug fixes:
	- Roll: time jumping and time mode change issues fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
New:
	- Optional loop points for Automation Sequencer. They snap to grid on Beat mode. 
	- Trays can now be square-shaped. Change the shape from the context menu.
	
	Changes:
	- Tuning again the Windows Audio driver release on app quit.
	- UI Rendering optimization for Roll object.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
New:
	- Introducing Automation Sequencer:
	Non-audio rate plot-like sequencer for controlling/automating any parameter of any object over small or large time periods.
	Manual included.
	- MIDI file import learn to Matrix object. Select what tracks on the MIDI file are used.
	- Data Filter new mode : Delta/Change : triggers pass through only when input value changes. 

	Bug fixes:
	- Sample voice release improved.
	- Audio device release on quit rewritten.
	- Lots of UI fixes.

	Changes to some keyboard controls: 
	- Tab key now opens the Automation Sequencer (and adds a parameter track to it)
	- C key does object focus instead.

notes.title: Update 1.2.9
notes.content:
New:
	- Project Save and Save as differentiation.
	- Project overwrite save confirmation.

	Bug fixes:
	- All envelopes improved significantly. 
	- PolyOSC : envelope mode switch fixed. 
Existing PolyOSC objects need to be recreated.

notes.title: Update 1.2.8
notes.content:
New:
	- Object duplication.
	- Rectangular object selection mode (default), along with the experimental circular one.
	control settings updated.

	Bug fixes:
	- Lots of UI fixes to objects and editors.

Also the included Opus audio codec (libopus.dll) is now rebuilt without a stack protector.
This might improve compatibility with Windows 8 and Windows 11 systems.

notes.title: Update 1.2.7
notes.content: Minor update to fix things on various objects and UI.

notes.title: Update 1.2.6
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
	- Distortion: threshold can now be controlled via sync input. 
	- Matrix: voices now turn also off when using external time from input(s).
	- Keys : "autogliding" in Poly mode now won't turn off some voices that are still hold playing.
	- All objects with envelopes: attack and release minimum (zero) values won't sound nasty.
	- Minor UI bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.content:
New:
	- Pad object : X/Y control (touch) pad for numbers and CV signals. Can also send triggers. 
	- DSP toggle to switch all dsp processing on/off (for keeping the app on background without CPU load)
	- Object/Context menu for object connections (only delete for now). 
	  Also now the context menu name changes according the selection (object, connection or tray).

	Bug fixes: 
	- MIDI Out : CC/Bend signals could produce a flood of midi messages at audio rate.  
	  Now midi sent only when the current value differs (at 8-bit midi resolution) from the previous value. 
	- Keys : percussive/sustain mode now working.
	- Keys (with locked input) can now be played while operating menus, dialogs and everything.
	- Sample editor: slices can be preview-played with right-mouse also in pitch/vol/pan edit modes. 

        And various UI fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.2.4
notes.content: Small fixes to few objects.

notes.title: Update 1.2.3
notes.content: Minor fixes to few objects.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
- Auto-connect mode now set in Control settings (and off as default)
- Small ui fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content: Small fixes to various UI bugs + file browsering permission request for macOS version.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
New:
	- Wavetable object: Mono/Poly oscillator with customizable band-limited waveform (and waveform editor).
	- Toggle object: Like Button but sends On/Off triggers according it's change of state.
	- State Machine : View of the time sum (HH:MM:SS.MS) of complete sequence.
	- Map : Maps/Scales can now be saved and loaded from files, sorted in folders according tuning system sizes.
	  Preset scales added for 12 (Western), 17 (Turkish/Persian/I Dunno), 22 (Indian) and 24 (Arabic) tone systems.

	Changes:
	- Vector: Sums are calculated from the whole Return (L)ength, looping over pattern lengths. 
	- Roll: Right mouse note play now in all Roll edit modes.
	- All oscillators : Default triangle waveform recreated (less sharp, more smooth).
	- When creating new object while an existing one is selected, a connection is automatically made from old to new.
	- When creating a new object while a connection is selected, the object is automatically connected between the two. 
	- Button : Right mouse triggers an Off signal when clicked.
		
	Bug fixes:
	- Sockets: Network stream buffer size tripled from 2 ms to 6 ms (more latency, more stability).
	  Running audio sockets along with high DSP recommended only for CPUs with 4 cores or more. 
	- Sample: Loading huge (whole song) files won't create unnecessarily high-def waveform models for UI.
	- All oscillators: Waveforms are now normalized...
	- Many UI Fixes.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Changes:
	- Operator object: new mode : MOD aka modulo.
	- MIDI CC numbers start from zero (0-127), not from one (1-128)
		
	Bug fixes:
	- Keys object monoAG mode key off trigger fixed.
	- macOS audio input permission request added.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
New:
	- UI font selection from various (more) inspirational styles.  
		
	Bug fixes:
	- MP3 file loading fixed for Windows version.
	- Sample editor truncate function fixed.
	- Sample editor mouse control improved.
